description: This file defines a custom matcher class for testing purposes, specifically to check if a string ends with a specific suffix. It is part of the testing suite for the OFBiz widget renderer macro component.

classes.name: MacroCallParameterStringValueEndsWithMatcher
classes.description: A custom matcher class extending TypeSafeMatcher that checks if a given string ends with a specified suffix.

methods.name: MacroCallParameterStringValueEndsWithMatcher
methods.description: Constructor initializing the matcher with the suffix to check.

methods.name: matchesSafely
methods.description: Overrides the method to perform the match, returning true if the item is a String ending with the specified suffix.

methods.name: describeTo
methods.description: Provides a textual description of the matcher, indicating what it checks for.

methods.name: describeMismatchSafely
methods.description: Provides a description for a mismatched item during testing.
